scripts.build: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=backend run build && npm --workspace=frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=shared run test --if-present && npm --workspace=backend run test && npm --workspace=frontend run test --if-present
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=backend run lint --if-present && npm --workspace=frontend run lint --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck
